name: brain_record
description: Start or stop recording laps the user drives by hand, for the brain to learn from. With the truck running, start records laps until `laps` more have completed (a crashed lap restarts at the start); with then_autopilot it then trains and lets the Autopilot drive the slalom, so "drive it yourself twice and I'll learn it" is one call: start true, laps 2, then_autopilot true. Stop aborts the lap being driven. With no truck running it drives the brain panel's preview.

laps.description: Completed laps to record before stopping (default 2).

then_autopilot.description: Train and run the Autopilot when the laps are done (default false).

name: brain_train
description: Train the brain on the completed laps (at least 2), a few ms a frame, with its live loss curve. With no truck running it starts the brain panel's training preview.

name: autopilot_on
description: Let the trained brain drive the truck through the slalom: each trained candidate, then the pretrained fallback, gets a run until one completes. With no truck running it shows the brain panel's Autopilot preview.

name: autopilot_off
description: Stop the Autopilot and give the truck back to the manual controller. With no truck running it returns the brain panel's preview to its ready state.

name: brain_status
description: Read the brain's state: mode (idle, lap, training, autopilot), completed laps, laps to go, training progress, who drove the last Autopilot run, and preview_only (true when no truck is running and only the panel preview answers).
